To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that

China has created the largest engineered venture market in the world, which is attributable to the government’s simultaneous efforts to improve capital supply, enhance the role of financial intermediaries, and encourage entrepreneurship.

the rise of the Chinese venture capital market is attributable to the simultaneous availability of (1) capital with the appetite and capacity for high-risk, high-return investments, and (2) entrepreneurs with the skills, incentives, and connections to put that capital into productive use.
China’s venture capital market has grown rapidly in recent years, and that this growth has resulted from the Chinese government’s efforts to engineer the market.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the role of the government in engineering a market for high-risk, high-reward investments.
the role of the state in engineering a venture market, and how the state can best do so.
the role of government in engineering a venture capitalist market, and how government policy can affect the development of a venture capitalist market.
In summary, a comprehensive and detailed conclusive statement would be that
China’s experience demonstrates the feasibility and desirability of engineering a venture capital regime to foster entrepreneurship.
the Chinese venture capital market has been engineered to a large extent, which is a combination of the government’s efforts and the market’s forces.
the Chinese venture capital market is the most successful example of the simultaneous availability of venture capital and entrepreneurial talent in the world.
A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

the Chinese government has successfully engineered a venture capital market through its simultaneous efforts to increase the supply of capital, improve the availability of financial institutions and encourage entrepreneurship.
the Chinese government has been able to engineer an environment for venture capital to thrive.
the government can play a significant role in creating a vibrant venture capital market, and that the government can do it in an efficient way.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the Chinese government has created the most effective institutional environment for venture capital development in the world by combining market-oriented policies with government intervention.

China’s success in creating a venture capital market is attributable not only to the Chinese government’s active role in the market, but also the Chinese market’s ability to rely on market forces to allocate capital.
China’s experience suggests that the government should play a more active role in engineering the market, especially in developing countries.
